exercises.title: Edit distance
exercises.task: Fill the table of EditDistance: first its edges, then every cell from its three neighbours above and to the left. Run also counts the calls of the same definition written as plain recursion: that is the difference a table makes.
hints: The edges: d[i][0] = i for every row, d[0][j] = j for every column.
Go 1.21 has a built-in min that takes any number of arguments: d[i][j] = min(a, b, c).

exercises.title: Did you mean…?
exercises.task: Spell checkers, search engines and command lines all suggest a correction for a typo: the known word with the smallest edit distance. Fill Suggest. Run corrects typos in Go keywords.
hints: Return "", false as soon as k == word.
Keep k when d < bestDist, or when d == bestDist and k < best.
